model = "m"

[mcp_servers."q-x"]   # a quoted name and a comment
command = "/bin/echo"

[mcp_servers.'lit-y']
command = "/bin/echo"
enabled = "yes"

[mcp_servers.set-a]
command = "/bin/echo"

[mcp_servers."esc\u0041pe"]
command = "/bin/echo"

[mcp_servers.sub-z]
command = "/bin/echo"

[mcp_servers.sub-z.env]
LEVEL = "1"

[mcp_servers.own-off]
enabled = false
command = "/bin/echo"

[projects."/tmp/p"]
trust_level = "trusted"

[mcp_servers.last-w]
command = "/bin/echo"
